positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: I worked with an analyst and a developer to improve the method of labeling different types of clients. My main tasks were to organize and group data attributes, and reconcile the needs and expectations of several downstream systems. Ultimately, we constructed a coding system that was more maintainable and extensible than the previous one, which downstream systems could use on several levels to meet their needs.
